name: Langley's No. 8
official_name: Langley's London Dry Gin (formerly Langley's No.8 Distilled London Gin)
serve_official: Traditional gin and tonic (Master of Malt)
notes: 'No.8' refers to eight botanicals (only four named); ABV was the eighth of twelve strengths tasted. Awards: SFWSC Gold 2014, IWSC Silver 2014, Great Taste 3-star 2015, Gin Masters Gold 2016 & 2022. Now sold as Langley's London Dry Gin [cần kiểm tra tên hiện hành].
